results.text: Site-specific activation of the proton pump inhibitor rabeprazole by tetrathiolate zinc centres. Proton pump inhibitors have become top-selling drugs worldwide. Serendipitously discovered as prodrugs that are activated by protonation in acidic environments, proton pump inhibitors inhibit stomach acid secretion by covalently modifying the gastric proton pump.
